delete.description:
Delete a dataset, and with it any training runs that left nothing behind.

`training_runs.dataset_id` is a real foreign key, so a dataset that was
ever trained on cannot simply be dropped -- Postgres raises, and the
endpoint used to answer 500. What actually deserves protecting is not
the fact that training happened but the artifact it produced: a
`ModelVersion` is the only record of where a set of weights came from.
So a run holding no ModelVersion (it failed, or its weights were
deleted afterwards) is deleted along with the dataset, while a run that
still owns weights refuses the delete and names them. Blocking on runs
alone would tell the user to remove models that no longer exist.

InferenceRunStatus.title: InferenceRunStatus
InferenceRunStatus.description: No STOPPED: cancelling a run is out of scope for the first QC slice.

ModelMetricsRead.title: ModelMetricsRead
ModelMetricsRead.description:
Everything the Info panel draws, in one request.

Deliberately not folded into ModelVersionRead: the models list is
polled, and a 180-class confusion matrix is ~130 KB per row -- the
same reason log_text is not part of TrainingRunRead.

QcFlagKind.title: QcFlagKind
QcFlagKind.description:
fp: nothing real in the frame (saved as a hard negative).
fn: a real object needs labelling (saved unannotated).

TrainingLogRead.title: TrainingLogRead
TrainingLogRead.description:
The log tail past a caller-supplied offset. Never bundled into
TrainingRunRead: over an hour log_text grows to megabytes, and the
status is polled every two seconds.

TrainingRunStatus.title: TrainingRunStatus
TrainingRunStatus.description:
Deliberately parallel to JobStatus rather than reusing it: a run can
end as STOPPED, which is neither success nor failure, and widening an
enum shared by every job type to serve one of them is worse than a
neighbouring enum.

VideoUpdate.title: VideoUpdate
VideoUpdate.description:
Rename a video's display title. The stored `filename` is the storage
object's identity and is deliberately not editable.
